title: Safeguarded Learning-Assisted Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient Methods
abstract: arXiv:2611.25707v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A learning-assisted framework for Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient (NCG) methods is developed in which lightweight online prediction is used to support, rather than replace, the classical optimization process. The proposed approach retains the standard two-term NCG structure and introduces two independent online extreme learning machine models. The first model predicts an NCG coefficient during restart recovery or when persistent stagnation is detected, whereas the second model is used only after a line-search failure in finite precision arithmetic to propose a bounded correction to the deterministic fallback step size. Neural predictions are accepted only when they satisfy deterministic numerical safeguards, including descent, scale, and out-of-distribution requirements; otherwise, the corresponding deterministic recovery or fallback mechanism is retained. translated_title: 带安全保障的学习辅助非线性共轭梯度方法
translated_abstract: 为非线性共轭梯度（NCG）方法开发了一种学习辅助框架，其中轻量级在线预测用于支持而非替代经典优化过程。所提出的方法保留了标准的两项非线性共轭梯度结构，并引入了两个独立的在线极限学习机模型。第一个模型在重启恢复期间或检测到持续停滞时预测非线性共轭梯度系数，而第二个模型仅在有限精度算术下发生线搜索失败后使用，用于对确定性回退步长提出有界修正。神经预测仅在其满足确定性数值安全保障（包括下降性、尺度和分布外要求）时才被接受；否则，将保留相应的确定性恢复或回退机制。两个学习模型均利用优化过程中已经生成的量进行在线更新。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种带安全保障的学习辅助非线性共轭梯度方法框架，通过两个在线极限学习机模型在重启恢复、停滞检测和线搜索失败时辅助经典优化过程，且神经预测仅在满足下降性、尺度等确定性数值安全条件时才被采纳。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a safeguarded learning-assisted framework for Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient methods, where two online extreme learning machine models support the classical optimization process during restart recovery, stagnation, and line-search failures, with neural predictions accepted only when deterministic numerical safeguards are satisfied.
